title.en: An Act Establishing the Buyabod School of Arts and Trade in the Municipality of Sta. Cruz, Province of Marinduque. and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing the Buyabod School of Arts and Trade in the Municipality of Sta. Cruz, Province of Marinduque. and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường Buyabod Nghệ thuật và Thương mại tại Đô thị Sta. Cruz, Tỉnh Marinduque., và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียน Buyabod ศิลปะและหัตถกรรม ในเทศบาล Sta. Cruz จังหวัด Marinduque. และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้
title.id: Undang-Undang membentuk Sekolah Buyabod Seni dan Keterampilan di Kotamadya Sta. Cruz, Provinsi Marinduque., dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Sekolah Buyabod Seni dan Pertukangan di Perbandaran Sta. Cruz, Wilayah Marinduque., dan memperuntukkan dana untuk itu

text.en: There shall be established under the supervision of the Technical Education and Skills Development Authority (TESDA) the Buyabod School of Arts and Trade in the Municipality of Sta. Cruz, Province of Marinduque.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
